adapter_evidence.row_semantics: inline 0x18-byte FactionItem rows; only the uint32 faction identity at +0x00 is read
adapter_evidence.producer_limit: The leaf getter is folded and has multiple direct callsites. No exact producer/writer is claimed by this package.

capture_seam.owner: GetTargetingFactions GUI callback immediately after the exact leaf getter

each_capture_requires: admission before the first targeting-state read
captured row count equals admitted campaign-root player_targeting_faction_count
two equal faction-id, target-character-id, canonical-leader and complete character-member copies from each inline 0x18-byte targeting row
equal proof epoch, revision, date, player identity and campaign-root targeting count after the second complete copy
every faction id resolves and round-trips
every target CharacterID resolves, full-generation round-trips and equals the admitted player identity
canonical leader is either a legal nullable absence or a resolved full-generation CharacterID; special character is never substituted
each signed character-member count is between zero and the per-faction bound of 64
positive member count has non-null data and count*0x20 addressing is overflow-safe
every member CharacterID resolves and full-generation round-trips
every member row owner FactionID equals the enclosing targeting-row faction identity
member CharacterIDs are unique within each faction
transaction.publication: owned faction, target, nullable canonical-leader and bounded character-member identities sorted by faction id plus the admitted campaign-root count are published with an odd/even generation; any failure retains the previous complete generation

pointer_boundary.process_local_addresses: targeting/member containers and rows are borrowed only during synchronous capture and are never published

evidence_limit: FACTION6-CORE implements the private/default-off same-admission canonical nullable leader and bounded 0x20 character-member reader with deterministic fixtures and previous-generation retention. Paused exact-build live/heartbeat capture, type, war, power/discontent, stock dangerous predicate and public MCP/schema promotion remain unproven.

same_admission_join.count_gate: FactionsWindow+0x144 row count equals admitted campaign-root count
same_admission_join.target_gate: every resolved CFaction+0x40 CharacterID equals admitted player_character_id
double_sample_fields: CFaction+0x48 member data and CFaction+0x54 signed count
each 0x20 member row CharacterID +0x08 and owner FactionID +0x0C

canonical_leader_identity.leader_present_in_character_members: derived only by comparing the accepted canonical leader ID with accepted character_member_ids

character_member_vector.count_separation: per-faction character-member count is independent of outer targeting_faction_count and the stock display total that adds county members

typed_failures.leader_character: canonical leader field cannot be read, or a resolver-produced non-null Character object fails full-generation round-trip; an unresolved leader remains a legal nullable absence
typed_failures.leader_stability: canonical leader presence or identity differs between the two same-admission copies
typed_failures.member_span: signed count, bound, null-data or overflow-safe 0x20 addressing fails
typed_failures.member_stability: member data/count or complete member ID/owner sequence differs between copies
typed_failures.member_identity: member CharacterID cannot be read, resolved, full-generation round-tripped or is duplicated within its faction
typed_failures.member_ownership: member row owner FactionID does not equal the enclosing targeting-row faction identity
typed_failures.failure_publication: all failures reject the candidate capture and retain the previous complete generation
